versions.changelog: 更新描述至最新项目定位

Initial release of agent-effect-operations (AEO):

- Measure agent performance and attribute outcomes to specific agents.
- Track quality trends over time and detect changes in agent output.
- Optimize costs by modeling token use, task durations, and retry rates.
- Provide real-time SLA monitoring (completion rate, latency, error rate) and alerting.
- Detect agent performance degradation and trigger evolution workflows automatically.
- Part of the Self-Evolving Harness operations infrastructure.
